implementation_commit: Containing Git commit versions this record. Owner appearance/interaction approval remains pending.
scope: Normal production graph/viewer/timeline presentation cutover, not full compositor/editor parity. Existing session/history/router/rendering owners retained.

owner_clarification.decision: Remove temporary test controls, not preserve them in popups. Prototype controls define the visible contract. Unsupported future actions disabled. Existing --source supplies real media for verification.

removed: Graph add-name/connection-port/parameter/output/playhead forms and temporary history buttons
Timeline cache-range/counters/source slip-rate forms and permanent debug/status chrome
No legacy shell switch or copied prototype authoritative models

migrated_controls.implemented: Compact target/role menu, shared display combo arrangement, narrow second-row transport, editable frame, first/previous/next seeking, real fit/50%/100% zoom and pan over actual ViewerItem. Display settings read workspace panel state, without a second writable local model.

Reference Frame all/Tools/zoom header; real catalog category creation through existing commands; Root breadcrumb, 24px reference grid, native 112x28 category-colored nodes, contrast labels, straight connections and port dots. Frame all remains disabled until #44.
Reference compact glyph header; native source-ruler seeking and source selection. Editorial glyphs disabled. Source references are not represented as authored editorial occurrences.

Theme supplied before QML construction; panel-local headerTools Component/headerToolsFillWidth; reactive panel IDs/groups preserve actions across workspace switches. Existing registry/docking/persistence/router remain authoritative.

future_ownership.remaining: Routing semantic review; groups/roles/pinning retained, not independent output rendering.
Graph authored layout, pan/zoom/framing, selection/deletion, wiring/reroutes, subnets/navigation.

Independent viewer destinations/targets, playback, marks/loops, authoritative timecode, layer/channel processing. Those controls are visibly unavailable; end-frame is unavailable when media length is unknown. Existing unknown-length preview range remains 0..239.
Real Media Bin/import/probing UI; no fixture catalog or viewer path entry.
Authored editorial sequences/occurrences, full timeline gestures, assembly and audio; native drawing still shows real source references.
